p: when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem: Christ by his humility, triumphing over the pride of this world, ascends to true glory by the shame of the cross.
he will send them: He that will say anything to you will let them go, that is, the ass and the colt.
daughter of Sion: The city of Sion. This is a Hebrew idiom, common in the Lamentations of Jeremiah.
clothes: Their uppermost garment.
thereon: Upon their garments, not upon the ass and the colt.

Hosanna to the Son of David: This was an ancient kind of cry, which they voiced in the feast of Tabernacles, when they carried boughs according as God commanded; Le 23:40. And the word is corruptly made of two, for we should say, "Hoshiang-na", which is as much as to say, "Save I pray thee".
Blessed is he that cometh in: Well is it to him that comes in the Name of the Lord, that is to say, whom the Lord has given us for our King.
all the city was moved: That is, all the men of Jerusalem were moved.
And when the chief priests and: Those that should be masters of godliness are the ones that envy most the glory of Christ: but in vain.

perfected praise: You have made most perfect. We read in David, "Thou hast established" or "grounded", and if the matter is considered well, the evangelist says here the same thing, for that which is most perfect is stable and sure.
And he left them: Christ does in this way forsake the wicked, for he has a consideration and regard for his Church.
Now in the morning as he: Hypocrites will at length have their masks discovered, and any false faces taken away.
Jesus answered and said unto them: How great the force of faith is.
doubt not: The Greek word signifies a fixing or wavering of mind, so that we cannot tell which way to take.
And when he was come into: Against those who neglect the doctrine and bind the calling and vocation to an ordinary succession, going about by that false pretext, to stop Christ's mouth.
authority doest thou these things: Or by what power.
one thing: One thing, that is to say, I will ask you one thing first before I answer your questions.
baptism of John: The preaching of John is called by the figure "baptism" because he preached the baptism of repentance, etc.; Mr 1:4 Ac 19:3.
heaven: From God, and so it is plainly seen how these are set one against another.
reasoned with themselves: Beat their heads about it, and mused, or laid their heads together.

go into the kingdom of God: They hurry to the kingdom of God and you go slowly, so that you should at least have followed their example. Mark then that this word, "go into", is improperly taken in this place because none of them followed Christ.
way of righteousness: Living uprightly, being of good and honest behaviour; For the Hebrews use this word "way" for life and manners.
Hear another parable: Those men are often the cruellest enemies of the Church, to whose faithfulness it is committed: But the vocation of God is neither tied to time, place, nor person.
tower: Made the place strong: for a tower is the strongest place of a wall.
seize on his inheritance: Literally, "let us hold it fast".
miserably destroy those wicked men: A kind of proverb, showing what punishment the wicked are worthy of.
builders rejected: Master builders, who are chief builders of the house, that is of the Church.
become the: Began to be.
head of the corner: The chiefest stone in the corner is called the head of the corner: which bears up the couplings or joints of the whole building.
this is the Lord's doing: That matter (in that the stone which was cast away is made the head) is the Lord's doing which we behold and greatly marvel at.
fruits thereof: They bring forth the fruits of the kingdom of God, who bring forth the fruit of the Spirit, and not of the flesh, Ga 5:16-26.
grind him to powder: As chaff used to be scattered with the wind, for he uses a word which properly signifies separating the chaff from the corn with winnowing, and to scatter it abroad.
But when they sought to lay: The wicked can do nothing but what God wills.
